claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Changelog-based revalidation on 2026-09-20 covering the 2.1.275 → 2.1.278 delta on top of the prior run's live-CLI 2.1.274 review, then confirmed live on 2026-09-21 — that run's runner had the `claude` CLI installed and `claude --version` reported `2.1.278 (Claude Code)`, matching the target exactly. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance from 2.1.274 to **2.1.278** together (no divergence). Reviewed each release: 2.1.275 added `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>` for explicit marketplace targeting when a plugin name exists in more than one added marketplace — documented in the install guide's Useful-flags section; also added syncing of skills/plugins enabled on the claude.ai account into terminal sessions (previously cloud-session-only), opt-out via `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` / `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false` — extends the existing 2.1.239 `@synced` documentation to terminal sessions, noted there; a plugin/marketplace secret-in-URL leak fix and a `marketplace update` fetch-failure-deletes-local-copy fix are both reviewed and inapplicable (this catalog's manifests use the credential-free `github`+`repo` shorthand, never a raw URL, and no consumer has reported a failed `marketplace update` against this repo). 2.1.276 shipped no itemized changelog entries beyond bug fixes — reviewed, nothing to adopt, matching the 2.1.264/2.1.266/2.1.270/2.1.272 fix-only precedent. 2.1.277 added AGENTS.md as a CLAUDE.md fallback for projects with no CLAUDE.md — this repo ships both, so contributors here are unaffected, but noted in AGENTS.md as now being read directly by Claude Code (not just imported via CLAUDE.md) on any project that lacks a CLAUDE.md of its own; **removed the deprecated TaskOutput tool** — searched the full repo (`search_code` for `TaskOutput`) and found zero references in any skill, doc, or script, so this breaking change has no effect here; the batch of `claude plugin install`-related bug fixes (reinstall-in-use, `/plugin` control-char stripping, property-named-plugin crashes, uninstalled plugins reappearing as failed rows, missing commit recording in `installed_plugins.json`, stale unpacked reload-preview copies) are reviewed and are host-side install-flow fixes with no manifest or skill surface for a catalog to act on. 2.1.278 changed Auto mode's default classifier for API/Enterprise/Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway users to the server-side one, with `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to opt out, and added an "Auto mode server" `/status` row — a billing/runtime behavior with no marketplace-manifest, plugin-source, or skill-loading surface for this catalog. `claude plugin validate --strict --json .agents/skills` (via `make validate-skills`) and a full `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests, `make agent:check`, 3 plugins in sync, no drift) were both re-run against the live 2.1.278 CLI on 2026-09-21 and passed clean.

cursor.supported_min_source: Cursor documents no minimum version for plugins; the floor is the version actually validated rather than guessed. The previous 0.45.0 floor predates Cursor's plugin system entirely
cursor.verification_method: latest desktop build from official Cursor download links (3.18.9, 2026-08-30 stable) cross-checked against cursor.com/changelog (feature 3.11; date-only entries through 2026-09-02 Self-Hosted Machines / Team Pools / partner sandboxes / computer use); team-marketplace import is a Dashboard flow

codex.supported_min_source: earliest release this catalog has claimed .agents/plugins/marketplace.json support for
codex.verification_method: documentary revalidation by this repo's standing Codex method (official release notes plus catalog compatibility review; the Codex CLI is not installed on the review machine). Reviewed every openai/codex release from 0.148.0 through 0.153.4 for plugin/marketplace changes: #41208 (0.151.0) reports invalid project marketplaces without hiding valid plugins, #41953 (0.153.0) enforces a marketplace source policy for OpenAI-curated plugins only, and #42149/#42150 (0.153.0) upgrade Git marketplaces from merged configuration and add remote-marketplace support to the plugin CLI. None alter the portable Agent Plugin catalog shape, so .agents/plugins/marketplace.json remains discoverable unchanged; 0.153.0 widens how it can be consumed rather than narrowing it.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: `opencode --version` on the maintainer machine (reported 1.18.29); latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — skill discovery is verified directly with `opencode debug skill`, pointing `skills.paths` at this repo's `.agents/skills` and confirming `run-plugins-catalog` resolves to its `SKILL.md`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
